verdict.rationale: Policy-as-code is a fair question for an infrastructure-as-code tool, but the evidence shows no built-in policy engine or policy gate that blocks non-compliant changes before apply. `tofu test` is an adjacent feature: it creates real infrastructure to check assertions and then destroys it. Speculative plans and saved plan files (`-out`) are only building blocks that an external policy tool could consume, so neither earns credit.
